342	def _validate_trade(
343	    record: object,
344	    accepted: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
345	    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
346	) -> dict[str, Any]:
347	    if not isinstance(record, dict) \
348	            or set(record.keys()) != set(_TRADE_FIELDS):
349	        raise ValueError("trade record has invalid fields")
350	    job_id = record["job_id"]
351	    at = record["at"]
352	    work = record["work"]
353	    resource_id = record["resource_id"]
354	    version = record["version"]
355	    if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
356	        raise ValueError("trade job_id must be a non-empty string")
357	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
358	        raise ValueError("trade at must be a non-boolean non-negative "
359	                         "integer")
360	    if not _is_plain_int(work) or work <= 0:
361	        raise ValueError("trade work must be a positive integer")
362	    if not isinstance(resource_id, str) or not resource_id:
363	        raise ValueError("trade resource_id must be a non-empty string")
364	    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version < 1:
365	        raise ValueError("trade version must be a positive integer")
366	    selection = record["selection"]
367	    if not isinstance(selection, dict) \
368	            or set(selection.keys()) != set(_SELECTION_FIELDS):
369	        raise ValueError("trade selection has invalid fields")
370	    if selection["resource_id"] != resource_id \
371	            or not isinstance(selection["resource_id"], str):
372	        raise ValueError("trade selection does not name its resource")
373	    if selection["version"] != version:
374	        raise ValueError("trade selection does not name its version")
375	
376	    job = accepted.get(job_id)
377	    if job is None:
378	        raise ValueError("trade must reference an accepted job")
379	    if work != job["work"]:
380	        raise ValueError("trade work does not match its accepted job")
381	    records = history.get(resource_id)
382	    if records is None or version > len(records):
383	        raise ValueError("trade must reference a published resource version")
384	
385	    candidates_raw = record["candidates"]
386	    if not isinstance(candidates_raw, list) or not candidates_raw:
387	        raise ValueError("trade candidates must be a non-empty list")
388	    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
389	    last_rank: tuple[int, int, str] | None = None
390	    seen: set[str] = set()
391	    for entry_raw in candidates_raw:
392	        rank = _validate_candidate(entry_raw, work, at, job, history, seen)
393	        if last_rank is not None and rank < last_rank:
394	            raise ValueError("trade candidates must be ordered by carbon "
395	                             "intensity, unit cost and resource id")
396	        last_rank = rank
397	        candidates.append(copy.deepcopy(entry_raw))
398	
399	    # The first ordered candidate is the unique winner.
400	    winner = candidates[0]["resource"]
401	    if winner["resource_id"] != resource_id or winner["version"] != version:
402	        raise ValueError("trade selection must be the first ordered "
403	                         "candidate")
404	    return {
405	        "job_id": job_id,
406	        "at": at,
407	        "work": work,
408	        "resource_id": resource_id,
409	        "version": version,
410	        "candidates": candidates,
411	        "selection": {"resource_id": resource_id, "version": version},
412	    }

415	def _validate_clear_ledger(
416	    data: object,
417	    accepted: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
418	    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
419	) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
420	    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data.keys()) != set(_CLEAR_ROOT_FIELDS):
421	        raise ValueError("clearing ledger root must be an object with keys "
422	                         "version, trades, idempotency and audit")
423	    version = data["version"]
424	    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version != _CLEAR_VERSION:
425	        raise ValueError("unsupported clearing ledger version")
426	
427	    trades_raw = data["trades"]
428	    idempotency_raw = data["idempotency"]
429	    audit_raw = data["audit"]
430	    if not isinstance(trades_raw, dict) \
431	            or not isinstance(idempotency_raw, dict) \
432	            or not isinstance(audit_raw, dict):
433	        raise ValueError("trades, idempotency and audit must be objects")
434	    _check_sorted_keys(trades_raw, "trades")
435	    _check_sorted_keys(idempotency_raw, "idempotency")
436	    _check_sorted_keys(audit_raw, "audit")
437	
438	    trades: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
439	    for job_id, record in trades_raw.items():
440	        if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
441	            raise ValueError("trade job ids must be non-empty strings")
442	        trade = _validate_trade(record, accepted, history)
443	        if trade["job_id"] != job_id:
444	            raise ValueError("trade record id does not match its key")
445	        trades[job_id] = trade
446	
447	    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
448	    events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
449	    referenced: set[str] = set()
450	    for key, binding in idempotency_raw.items():
451	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
452	            raise ValueError("idempotency keys must be non-empty strings")
453	        if not isinstance(binding, dict) \
454	                or set(binding.keys()) != {"job_id", "at"}:
455	            raise ValueError("idempotency binding has invalid fields")
456	        bound_job = binding["job_id"]
457	        bound_at = binding["at"]
458	        if not isinstance(bound_job, str) or not bound_job \
459	                or bound_job not in trades:
460	            raise ValueError("idempotency entry must reference a recorded "
461	                             "trade")
462	        if not _is_plain_int(bound_at) or bound_at < 0:
463	            raise ValueError("idempotency entry must bind an evaluation "
464	                             "moment")
465	        if bound_job in referenced:
466	            raise ValueError("job traded under more than one idempotency "
467	                             "key")
468	        referenced.add(bound_job)
469	        trade = trades[bound_job]
470	        if trade["at"] != bound_at:
471	            raise ValueError("idempotency entry does not match its trade")
472	        idempotency[key] = {"job_id": bound_job, "at": bound_at}
473	
474	    for key, event in audit_raw.items():
475	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
476	            raise ValueError("audit keys must be non-empty strings")
477	        if not isinstance(event, dict) \
478	                or set(event.keys()) != set(_EVENT_FIELDS):
479	            raise ValueError("clear audit event has invalid fields")
480	        event_key = event["key"]
481	        job_id = event["job_id"]
482	        at = event["at"]
483	        resource_id = event["resource_id"]
484	        event_version = event["version"]
485	        if event_key != key or not isinstance(event_key, str) or not event_key:
486	            raise ValueError("audit event key does not match its map key")
487	        if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id or job_id not in trades:
488	            raise ValueError("audit event must reference a recorded trade")
489	        if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
490	            raise ValueError("audit event at must be a non-negative integer")
491	        if not isinstance(resource_id, str) or not resource_id:
492	            raise ValueError("audit event resource_id must be a non-empty "
493	                             "string")
494	        if not _is_plain_int(event_version) or event_version < 1:
495	            raise ValueError("audit event version must be a positive integer")
496	        trade = trades[job_id]
497	        if at != trade["at"] or resource_id != trade["resource_id"] \
498	                or event_version != trade["version"]:
499	            raise ValueError("audit event does not match its trade")
500	        events[key] = {"key": event_key, "job_id": job_id, "at": at,
501	                       "resource_id": resource_id, "version": event_version}
502	
503	    # The three sections describe one clearing history: each idempotency
504	    # key binds one trade and one event, and each trade is bound exactly
505	    # once.
506	    if set(idempotency) != set(events):
507	        raise ValueError("idempotency keys and audit events do not match")
508	    for key, binding in idempotency.items():
509	        event = events[key]
510	        if event["job_id"] != binding["job_id"] or event["at"] != binding["at"]:
511	            raise ValueError("audit event does not match its idempotency "
512	                             "entry")
513	    if set(trades) != referenced:
514	        raise ValueError("every trade must be bound to an idempotency key")
515	
516	    # Recorded bookings may not oversell any published version; every
517	    # winner was feasible with the earlier trades' work deducted.
518	    booked: dict[tuple[str, int], int] = {}
519	    for trade in trades.values():
520	        slot = (trade["resource_id"], trade["version"])
521	        booked[slot] = booked.get(slot, 0) + trade["work"]
522	    for (resource_id, version), amount in booked.items():
523	        record = history[resource_id][version - 1]
524	        if record["capacity"] < amount:
525	            raise ValueError("ledger oversells a published resource version")
526	
527	    return trades, idempotency

579	    return trades, idempotency, raw

590	def _rollback_clear(realpath: str, directory: str, old_bytes: bytes | None,
591	                    first: BaseException) -> None:
592	    # Restore the exact pre-call bytes while the exclusive lock is held,
593	    # or remove a ledger that did not exist beforehand, then sync the
594	    # directory. A failed recovery chains after the original error.
595	    try:
596	        if old_bytes is None:
597	            try:
598	                os.unlink(realpath)
599	            except FileNotFoundError:
600	                pass
601	        else:
602	            fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
603	                dir=directory, prefix=".clear-restore-", suffix=".tmp")
604	            try:
605	                with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
606	                    handle.write(old_bytes)
607	                    handle.flush()
608	                    os.fsync(handle.fileno())
609	                os.replace(tmp_path, realpath)
610	            except BaseException:
611	                with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
612	                    os.unlink(tmp_path)
613	                raise
614	        _fsync_directory(directory)
615	    except OSError as recovery:
616	        raise recovery from first

619	def _commit_clear(realpath: str, payload: bytes,
620	                  old_bytes: bytes | None) -> None:
621	    # One durable commit for the trade, the idempotency binding and the
622	    # audit event: synced same-directory temporary, atomic replace and a
623	    # directory fsync, restoring the pre-call bytes on any failure.
624	    directory = os.path.dirname(realpath) or "."
625	    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
626	        dir=directory, prefix=".clear-", suffix=".tmp")
627	    try:
628	        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
629	            handle.write(payload)
630	            handle.flush()
631	            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
632	        os.replace(tmp_path, realpath)
633	    except BaseException:
634	        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
635	            os.unlink(tmp_path)
636	        raise
637	    try:
638	        _fsync_directory(directory)
639	    except BaseException as first:
640	        _rollback_clear(realpath, directory, old_bytes, first)
641	        raise

645	    jobs: str,
646	    supply: str,
647	    ledger: str,
648	    job_id: str,
649	    key: str,
650	    at: int,
651	) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
652	    """Clear one accepted job against the versioned supply idempotently.

654	    ``jobs``, ``supply`` and ``ledger`` paths, ``job_id`` and ``key``
655	    must be non-empty strings and ``at`` a non-boolean non-negative
656	    integer evaluation moment; the three paths must also resolve to
657	    distinct real locations. Any violation raises ``ValueError`` before
658	    a business file is read.
659	
660	    The ``jobs.submit`` acceptance file and the resource supply file are
661	    read as one snapshot under their shared locks together with the
662	    ledger's exclusive lock, all three taken in resolved real-path
663	    order. Only each resource's highest version valid at ``at`` is
664	    considered, and feasibility -- region, residency, cost and carbon
665	    budgets, deadline coverage and the candidate entries -- follows
666	    :func:`resources.feasible`. A version's capacity is additionally
667	    reduced by the work of every trade already booked against that exact
668	    resource version in the ledger, so capacity is never oversold and
669	    bookings never cross versions. Remaining candidates are ordered by
670	    carbon intensity, unit cost and resource id; the first is the unique
671	    winner.
672	
673	    Returns ``(trade, created)``; the trade binds the job, the
674	    evaluation moment, the work, the ordered candidate snapshot and a
675	    versioned selection. A missing ledger is created only on the first
676	    trade, the trade, its idempotency binding and the audit event
677	    binding the key, resource id and version committed in one synced
678	    atomic write. Replaying the same key with the same job and
679	    evaluation moment returns the stored trade with ``False`` without
680	    reselecting, appending or rewriting. The same key with a different
681	    request, or a job already traded under another key, raises
682	    ``ValueError`` with the ledger untouched.
683	
684	    An unknown job raises ``KeyError``; no remaining feasible resource
685	    raises ``LookupError``; neither creates the ledger. Missing input
686	    files or a missing ledger parent raise ``FileNotFoundError`` without
687	    leaving a ledger or temporary fragment. Invalid structure,
688	    references, ordering or canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; other
689	    locking, read/write or sync failures raise ``OSError``.
690	    """
691	    for value in (jobs, supply, ledger, job_id, key):
692	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
693	            raise ValueError("jobs, supply, ledger, job_id and key must be "

706	    with store.lock:
707	        # Locks are taken in one resolved-real-path order shared by
708	        # every caller, so concurrent clears can never deadlock; the
709	        # ledger lock is exclusive, both snapshots shared.
710	        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
711	            for locked in sorted({job_real, supply_real, ledger_real}):
712	                stack.enter_context(
713	                    _clear_lock(locked, shared=(locked != ledger_real)))
714	
715	            accepted, job_map, job_events, job_raw = \
716	                _jobs._load_submit_file(job_real)
717	            if job_raw is None:
718	                raise FileNotFoundError(
719	                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} does not exist")
720	            # Like the supply file and the ledger, the acceptance
721	            # snapshot must be in the canonical compact form jobs.submit
722	            # writes; this does not change resources.feasible, which keeps
723	            # its own documented read behavior.
724	            if job_raw != _jobs._serialize_submit_file(
725	                    accepted, job_map, job_events):

747	            if job_id in trades:

752	            # never re-enter this path, so every recorded trade counts

"""Persistent, thread-safe job-to-offer match and clearing ledgers."""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import copy
import fcntl
import json
import os
import tempfile
import threading
from typing import Any, Callable, Iterator

from . import jobs as _jobs
from . import offers as _offers
from . import resources as _resources
from ._jsonio import finite_loads, strict_loads

__all__ = ["match", "clear"]

_VERSION = 1
_MATCH_FIELDS = ("job_id", "resource_id")
_ROOT_FIELDS = ("version", "matches", "idempotency")


class _Store:
    def __init__(self, realpath: str) -> None:
        self.realpath = realpath
        self.lock = threading.Lock()


_stores_lock = threading.Lock()
_stores: dict[str, _Store] = {}


def _get_store(path: str) -> _Store:
    realpath = os.path.realpath(path)
    with _stores_lock:
        store = _stores.get(realpath)
        if store is None:
            store = _Store(realpath)
            _stores[realpath] = store
        return store


def _is_plain_int(value: object) -> bool:
    # bool is a subclass of int and must be rejected.
    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)


def _load_registry(
    realpath: str,
    validate: Callable[[object], tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], Any]],
    kind: str,
) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], Any]:
    # Unlike the registries themselves, match() requires the jobs and offers
    # files to exist, so FileNotFoundError (and any other OSError) propagates.
    with open(realpath, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        text = handle.read()
    try:
        data = strict_loads(text)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{kind} file {realpath!r} is not valid JSON") from exc
    return validate(data)


def _validate_ledger(
    data: object,
    job_ids: dict[str, Any],
    resource_ids: dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, str]], dict[str, str]]:
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data.keys()) != set(_ROOT_FIELDS):
        raise ValueError("ledger root must be an object with keys "
                         "version, matches and idempotency")

    version = data["version"]
    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version != _VERSION:
        raise ValueError("unsupported ledger version")

    matches_raw = data["matches"]
    idempotency_raw = data["idempotency"]
    if not isinstance(matches_raw, dict) or not isinstance(idempotency_raw, dict):
        raise ValueError("matches and idempotency must be objects")

    matches: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
    for name, record in matches_raw.items():
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
            raise ValueError("job ids must be non-empty strings")
        if not isinstance(record, dict) or set(record.keys()) != set(_MATCH_FIELDS):
            raise ValueError("match record has invalid fields")
        if record["job_id"] != name:
            raise ValueError("match record id does not match its key")
        resource_id = record["resource_id"]
        if not isinstance(resource_id, str) or not resource_id:
            raise ValueError("resource_id must be a non-empty string")
        if name not in job_ids:
            raise ValueError("match record must reference a registered job")
        if resource_id not in resource_ids:
            raise ValueError("match record must reference a registered offer")
        matches[name] = {"job_id": name, "resource_id": resource_id}

    idempotency: dict[str, str] = {}
    referenced: set[str] = set()
    for key, job_id in idempotency_raw.items():
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
            raise ValueError("idempotency keys must be non-empty strings")
        if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id or job_id not in matches:
            raise ValueError("idempotency entry must reference a recorded match")
        if job_id in referenced:
            raise ValueError("job matched under more than one idempotency key")
        referenced.add(job_id)
        idempotency[key] = job_id

    return matches, idempotency


def _load_ledger(
    realpath: str,
    job_ids: dict[str, Any],
    resource_ids: dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, str]], dict[str, str]]:
    try:
        with open(realpath, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            text = handle.read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return {}, {}

    try:
        data = strict_loads(text)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"ledger file {realpath!r} is not valid JSON") from exc
    return _validate_ledger(data, job_ids, resource_ids)


def _atomic_write(
    realpath: str,
    matches: dict[str, dict[str, str]],
    idempotency: dict[str, str],
) -> None:
    payload = {
        "version": _VERSION,
        "matches": {name: matches[name] for name in sorted(matches)},
        "idempotency": {key: idempotency[key] for key in sorted(idempotency)},
    }
    text = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"),
                      allow_nan=False) + "\n"

    directory = os.path.dirname(realpath) or "."
    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=directory, prefix=".ledger-",
                                    suffix=".tmp")
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
            handle.write(text)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp_path, realpath)
    except BaseException:
        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
            os.unlink(tmp_path)
        raise

    dir_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY)
    try:
        os.fsync(dir_fd)
    finally:
        os.close(dir_fd)


def match(
    jobs: str,
    offers: str,
    ledger: str,
    job_id: str,
    key: str,
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
    """Match a registered job to the greenest feasible offer idempotently.

    Candidates are offers whose region is permitted by the job's
    residency_regions and whose remaining capacity (capacity_wh minus the
    energy already allocated in the ledger) covers the job's energy_wh;
    the winner is the first by ascending carbon_intensity, unit_cost and
    resource_id. Returns ``(record, created)`` where ``record`` carries
    job_id and resource_id; ``created`` is ``True`` for a new match and
    ``False`` when the idempotency key replays a match for the same job
    (which allocates no further capacity).
    """
    for value in (jobs, offers, ledger, job_id, key):
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
            raise ValueError("jobs, offers, ledger, job_id and key must be "
                             "non-empty strings")

    store = _get_store(ledger)
    with store.lock:
        job_records, _ = _load_registry(
            os.path.realpath(jobs), _jobs._validate_structure, "jobs registry")
        if job_id not in job_records:
            raise KeyError(job_id)
        job = job_records[job_id]

        offer_records, _ = _load_registry(
            os.path.realpath(offers), _offers._validate_structure,
            "offers registry")
        matches, idempotency = _load_ledger(
            store.realpath, job_records, offer_records)

        existing = idempotency.get(key)
        if existing is not None:
            if existing != job_id:
                raise ValueError("idempotency key was already used with a "
                                 "different job")
            return dict(matches[job_id]), False
        if job_id in matches:
            raise ValueError("job is already matched under another "
                             "idempotency key")

        allocated: dict[str, int] = {}
        for record in matches.values():
            resource_id = record["resource_id"]
            allocated[resource_id] = (
                allocated.get(resource_id, 0)
                + job_records[record["job_id"]]["energy_wh"])

        allowed = set(job["residency_regions"])
        needed = job["energy_wh"]
        best: tuple[int, int, str] | None = None
        for resource_id, offer in offer_records.items():
            if offer["region"] not in allowed:
                continue
            if offer["capacity_wh"] - allocated.get(resource_id, 0) < needed:
                continue
            candidate = (offer["carbon_intensity"], offer["unit_cost"],
                         resource_id)
            if best is None or candidate < best:
                best = candidate
        if best is None:
            raise LookupError("no feasible offer for job")

        record = {"job_id": job_id, "resource_id": best[2]}
        matches[job_id] = record
        idempotency[key] = job_id
        _atomic_write(store.realpath, matches, idempotency)
        return dict(record), True


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Version 2: market clearing over jobs.submit acceptances and supply versions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_CLEAR_VERSION = 2
_CLEAR_ROOT_FIELDS = ("version", "trades", "idempotency", "audit")
_TRADE_FIELDS = ("job_id", "at", "work", "resource_id", "version",
                 "candidates", "selection")
_SELECTION_FIELDS = ("resource_id", "version")
_EVENT_FIELDS = ("key", "job_id", "at", "resource_id", "version")
_LOCK_SUFFIX = ".lock"


@contextlib.contextmanager
def _clear_lock(realpath: str, *, shared: bool = False) -> Iterator[None]:
    # As in resources.jobs, the companion lock file is never unlinked and
    # an flock is released by the kernel on process exit, so equivalent
    # real paths share one lock across threads and processes.
    lock_path = realpath + _LOCK_SUFFIX
    fd = os.open(lock_path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR, 0o666)
    try:
        fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_SH if shared else fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def _check_sorted_keys(mapping: dict[Any, Any], label: str) -> None:
    keys = list(mapping)
    if keys != sorted(keys):
        raise ValueError(f"{label} must be ordered by key code point")


def _validate_candidate(
    entry: object,
    work: int,
    at: int,
    job: dict[str, Any],
    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
    seen: set[str],
) -> tuple[int, int, str]:
    if not isinstance(entry, dict) \
            or set(entry.keys()) != {"resource", "total_cost",
                                     "total_carbon"}:
        raise ValueError("trade candidate has invalid fields")
    resource = entry["resource"]
    if not isinstance(resource, dict) \
            or set(resource.keys()) != set(_resources._RECORD_FIELDS):
        raise ValueError("trade candidate resource has invalid fields")
    # Strict value typing (booleans rejected), the same rules a
    # published version had to satisfy.
    _resources._check_values(resource)
    resource_id = resource["resource_id"]
    version = resource["version"]
    if not isinstance(resource_id, str) or not resource_id:
        raise ValueError("candidate resource_id must be a non-empty string")
    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version < 1:
        raise ValueError("candidate version must be a positive integer")
    # The versioned record must be the exact, immutable supply record.
    records = history.get(resource_id)
    if records is None or version > len(records) \
            or dict(resource) != records[version - 1]:
        raise ValueError("trade candidate must reference a published "
                         "resource version")
    if resource_id in seen:
        raise ValueError("trade candidates must be distinct resources")
    seen.add(resource_id)
    if not (resource["start"] <= at <= resource["end"]):
        raise ValueError("trade candidate must be valid at the trade's "
                         "evaluation moment")
    total_cost = entry["total_cost"]
    total_carbon = entry["total_carbon"]
    if not _is_plain_int(total_cost) or total_cost < 0 \
            or total_cost != work * resource["unit_cost"]:
        raise ValueError("trade candidate total_cost is invalid")
    if not _is_plain_int(total_carbon) or total_carbon < 0 \
            or total_carbon != work * resource["carbon_intensity"]:
        raise ValueError("trade candidate total_carbon is invalid")
    # The snapshot must still describe the same feasibility the trade
    # was decided under; published versions and accepted jobs never
    # change, so a valid trade stays valid forever.
    if resource["region"] not in set(job["regions"]):
        raise ValueError("trade candidate is outside the job's regions")
    if not set(job["residency"]) <= set(resource["residency"]):
        raise ValueError("trade candidate does not cover job residency")
    if resource["end"] < job["deadline"]:
        raise ValueError("trade candidate does not cover the job deadline")
    if total_cost > job["max_cost"] \
            or total_carbon > job["carbon_cap"]:
        raise ValueError("trade candidate exceeds a job budget")
    return resource["carbon_intensity"], resource["unit_cost"], resource_id


def _validate_trade(
    record: object,
    accepted: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(record, dict) \
            or set(record.keys()) != set(_TRADE_FIELDS):
        raise ValueError("trade record has invalid fields")
    job_id = record["job_id"]
    at = record["at"]
    work = record["work"]
    resource_id = record["resource_id"]
    version = record["version"]
    if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
        raise ValueError("trade job_id must be a non-empty string")
    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
        raise ValueError("trade at must be a non-boolean non-negative "
                         "integer")
    if not _is_plain_int(work) or work <= 0:
        raise ValueError("trade work must be a positive integer")
    if not isinstance(resource_id, str) or not resource_id:
        raise ValueError("trade resource_id must be a non-empty string")
    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version < 1:
        raise ValueError("trade version must be a positive integer")
    selection = record["selection"]
    if not isinstance(selection, dict) \
            or set(selection.keys()) != set(_SELECTION_FIELDS):
        raise ValueError("trade selection has invalid fields")
    if selection["resource_id"] != resource_id \
            or not isinstance(selection["resource_id"], str):
        raise ValueError("trade selection does not name its resource")
    if selection["version"] != version:
        raise ValueError("trade selection does not name its version")

    job = accepted.get(job_id)
    if job is None:
        raise ValueError("trade must reference an accepted job")
    if work != job["work"]:
        raise ValueError("trade work does not match its accepted job")
    records = history.get(resource_id)
    if records is None or version > len(records):
        raise ValueError("trade must reference a published resource version")

    candidates_raw = record["candidates"]
    if not isinstance(candidates_raw, list) or not candidates_raw:
        raise ValueError("trade candidates must be a non-empty list")
    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    last_rank: tuple[int, int, str] | None = None
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for entry_raw in candidates_raw:
        rank = _validate_candidate(entry_raw, work, at, job, history, seen)
        if last_rank is not None and rank < last_rank:
            raise ValueError("trade candidates must be ordered by carbon "
                             "intensity, unit cost and resource id")
        last_rank = rank
        candidates.append(copy.deepcopy(entry_raw))

    # The first ordered candidate is the unique winner.
    winner = candidates[0]["resource"]
    if winner["resource_id"] != resource_id or winner["version"] != version:
        raise ValueError("trade selection must be the first ordered "
                         "candidate")
    return {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "at": at,
        "work": work,
        "resource_id": resource_id,
        "version": version,
        "candidates": candidates,
        "selection": {"resource_id": resource_id, "version": version},
    }


def _validate_clear_ledger(
    data: object,
    accepted: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data.keys()) != set(_CLEAR_ROOT_FIELDS):
        raise ValueError("clearing ledger root must be an object with keys "
                         "version, trades, idempotency and audit")
    version = data["version"]
    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version != _CLEAR_VERSION:
        raise ValueError("unsupported clearing ledger version")

    trades_raw = data["trades"]
    idempotency_raw = data["idempotency"]
    audit_raw = data["audit"]
    if not isinstance(trades_raw, dict) \
            or not isinstance(idempotency_raw, dict) \
            or not isinstance(audit_raw, dict):
        raise ValueError("trades, idempotency and audit must be objects")
    _check_sorted_keys(trades_raw, "trades")
    _check_sorted_keys(idempotency_raw, "idempotency")
    _check_sorted_keys(audit_raw, "audit")

    trades: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for job_id, record in trades_raw.items():
        if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
            raise ValueError("trade job ids must be non-empty strings")
        trade = _validate_trade(record, accepted, history)
        if trade["job_id"] != job_id:
            raise ValueError("trade record id does not match its key")
        trades[job_id] = trade

    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    referenced: set[str] = set()
    for key, binding in idempotency_raw.items():
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
            raise ValueError("idempotency keys must be non-empty strings")
        if not isinstance(binding, dict) \
                or set(binding.keys()) != {"job_id", "at"}:
            raise ValueError("idempotency binding has invalid fields")
        bound_job = binding["job_id"]
        bound_at = binding["at"]
        if not isinstance(bound_job, str) or not bound_job \
                or bound_job not in trades:
            raise ValueError("idempotency entry must reference a recorded "
                             "trade")
        if not _is_plain_int(bound_at) or bound_at < 0:
            raise ValueError("idempotency entry must bind an evaluation "
                             "moment")
        if bound_job in referenced:
            raise ValueError("job traded under more than one idempotency "
                             "key")
        referenced.add(bound_job)
        trade = trades[bound_job]
        if trade["at"] != bound_at:
            raise ValueError("idempotency entry does not match its trade")
        idempotency[key] = {"job_id": bound_job, "at": bound_at}

    for key, event in audit_raw.items():
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
            raise ValueError("audit keys must be non-empty strings")
        if not isinstance(event, dict) \
                or set(event.keys()) != set(_EVENT_FIELDS):
            raise ValueError("clear audit event has invalid fields")
        event_key = event["key"]
        job_id = event["job_id"]
        at = event["at"]
        resource_id = event["resource_id"]
        event_version = event["version"]
        if event_key != key or not isinstance(event_key, str) or not event_key:
            raise ValueError("audit event key does not match its map key")
        if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id or job_id not in trades:
            raise ValueError("audit event must reference a recorded trade")
        if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
            raise ValueError("audit event at must be a non-negative integer")
        if not isinstance(resource_id, str) or not resource_id:
            raise ValueError("audit event resource_id must be a non-empty "
                             "string")
        if not _is_plain_int(event_version) or event_version < 1:
            raise ValueError("audit event version must be a positive integer")
        trade = trades[job_id]
        if at != trade["at"] or resource_id != trade["resource_id"] \
                or event_version != trade["version"]:
            raise ValueError("audit event does not match its trade")
        events[key] = {"key": event_key, "job_id": job_id, "at": at,
                       "resource_id": resource_id, "version": event_version}

    # The three sections describe one clearing history: each idempotency
    # key binds one trade and one event, and each trade is bound exactly
    # once.
    if set(idempotency) != set(events):
        raise ValueError("idempotency keys and audit events do not match")
    for key, binding in idempotency.items():
        event = events[key]
        if event["job_id"] != binding["job_id"] or event["at"] != binding["at"]:
            raise ValueError("audit event does not match its idempotency "
                             "entry")
    if set(trades) != referenced:
        raise ValueError("every trade must be bound to an idempotency key")

    # Recorded bookings may not oversell any published version; every
    # winner was feasible with the earlier trades' work deducted.
    booked: dict[tuple[str, int], int] = {}
    for trade in trades.values():
        slot = (trade["resource_id"], trade["version"])
        booked[slot] = booked.get(slot, 0) + trade["work"]
    for (resource_id, version), amount in booked.items():
        record = history[resource_id][version - 1]
        if record["capacity"] < amount:
            raise ValueError("ledger oversells a published resource version")

    return trades, idempotency


def _canonical_clear_bytes(
    trades: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> bytes:
    audit = {key: {
        "key": key,
        "job_id": trades[binding["job_id"]]["job_id"],
        "at": binding["at"],
        "resource_id": trades[binding["job_id"]]["resource_id"],
        "version": trades[binding["job_id"]]["version"],
    } for key, binding in idempotency.items()}
    payload = {
        "version": _CLEAR_VERSION,
        "trades": {job_id: trades[job_id] for job_id in sorted(trades)},
        "idempotency": {key: idempotency[key] for key in sorted(idempotency)},
        "audit": {key: audit[key] for key in sorted(audit)},
    }
    text = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"),
                      allow_nan=False) + "\n"
    return text.encode("utf-8")


def _load_clear_ledger(
    realpath: str,
    accepted: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]], bytes | None]:
    try:
        with open(realpath, "rb") as handle:
            raw = handle.read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return {}, {}, None
    try:
        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
        raise ValueError(
            f"clearing ledger {realpath!r} is not valid UTF-8") from exc
    try:
        # Negative-zero and non-finite literals are format errors.
        data = finite_loads(text)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(
            f"clearing ledger {realpath!r} is not valid JSON") from exc
    trades, idempotency = _validate_clear_ledger(data, accepted, history)
    # As for the supply file, the ledger is accepted only in canonical
    # compact form with a single trailing newline.
    if raw != _canonical_clear_bytes(trades, idempotency):
        raise ValueError(
            f"clearing ledger {realpath!r} is not in canonical compact form")
    return trades, idempotency, raw


def _fsync_directory(directory: str) -> None:
    dir_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY)
    try:
        os.fsync(dir_fd)
    finally:
        os.close(dir_fd)


def _rollback_clear(realpath: str, directory: str, old_bytes: bytes | None,
                    first: BaseException) -> None:
    # Restore the exact pre-call bytes while the exclusive lock is held,
    # or remove a ledger that did not exist beforehand, then sync the
    # directory. A failed recovery chains after the original error.
    try:
        if old_bytes is None:
            try:
                os.unlink(realpath)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
        else:
            fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
                dir=directory, prefix=".clear-restore-", suffix=".tmp")
            try:
                with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
                    handle.write(old_bytes)
                    handle.flush()
                    os.fsync(handle.fileno())
                os.replace(tmp_path, realpath)
            except BaseException:
                with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
                    os.unlink(tmp_path)
                raise
        _fsync_directory(directory)
    except OSError as recovery:
        raise recovery from first


def _commit_clear(realpath: str, payload: bytes,
                  old_bytes: bytes | None) -> None:
    # One durable commit for the trade, the idempotency binding and the
    # audit event: synced same-directory temporary, atomic replace and a
    # directory fsync, restoring the pre-call bytes on any failure.
    directory = os.path.dirname(realpath) or "."
    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
        dir=directory, prefix=".clear-", suffix=".tmp")
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
            handle.write(payload)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp_path, realpath)
    except BaseException:
        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
            os.unlink(tmp_path)
        raise
    try:
        _fsync_directory(directory)
    except BaseException as first:
        _rollback_clear(realpath, directory, old_bytes, first)
        raise


def clear(
    jobs: str,
    supply: str,
    ledger: str,
    job_id: str,
    key: str,
    at: int,
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
    """Clear one accepted job against the versioned supply idempotently.

    ``jobs``, ``supply`` and ``ledger`` paths, ``job_id`` and ``key``
    must be non-empty strings and ``at`` a non-boolean non-negative
    integer evaluation moment; the three paths must also resolve to
    distinct real locations. Any violation raises ``ValueError`` before
    a business file is read.

    The ``jobs.submit`` acceptance file and the resource supply file are
    read as one snapshot under their shared locks together with the
    ledger's exclusive lock, all three taken in resolved real-path
    order. Only each resource's highest version valid at ``at`` is
    considered, and feasibility -- region, residency, cost and carbon
    budgets, deadline coverage and the candidate entries -- follows
    :func:`resources.feasible`. A version's capacity is additionally
    reduced by the work of every trade already booked against that exact
    resource version in the ledger, so capacity is never oversold and
    bookings never cross versions. Remaining candidates are ordered by
    carbon intensity, unit cost and resource id; the first is the unique
    winner.

    Returns ``(trade, created)``; the trade binds the job, the
    evaluation moment, the work, the ordered candidate snapshot and a
    versioned selection. A missing ledger is created only on the first
    trade, the trade, its idempotency binding and the audit event
    binding the key, resource id and version committed in one synced
    atomic write. Replaying the same key with the same job and
    evaluation moment returns the stored trade with ``False`` without
    reselecting, appending or rewriting. The same key with a different
    request, or a job already traded under another key, raises
    ``ValueError`` with the ledger untouched.

    An unknown job raises ``KeyError``; no remaining feasible resource
    raises ``LookupError``; neither creates the ledger. Missing input
    files or a missing ledger parent raise ``FileNotFoundError`` without
    leaving a ledger or temporary fragment. Invalid structure,
    references, ordering or canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; other
    locking, read/write or sync failures raise ``OSError``.
    """
    for value in (jobs, supply, ledger, job_id, key):
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
            raise ValueError("jobs, supply, ledger, job_id and key must be "
                             "non-empty strings")
    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")

    job_real = os.path.realpath(jobs)
    supply_real = os.path.realpath(supply)
    ledger_real = os.path.realpath(ledger)
    if len({job_real, supply_real, ledger_real}) != 3:
        raise ValueError("jobs, supply and ledger paths must be distinct "
                         "real paths")

    store = _get_store(ledger)
    with store.lock:
        # Locks are taken in one resolved-real-path order shared by
        # every caller, so concurrent clears can never deadlock; the
        # ledger lock is exclusive, both snapshots shared.
        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
            for locked in sorted({job_real, supply_real, ledger_real}):
                stack.enter_context(
                    _clear_lock(locked, shared=(locked != ledger_real)))

            accepted, job_map, job_events, job_raw = \
                _jobs._load_submit_file(job_real)
            if job_raw is None:
                raise FileNotFoundError(
                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} does not exist")
            # Like the supply file and the ledger, the acceptance
            # snapshot must be in the canonical compact form jobs.submit
            # writes; this does not change resources.feasible, which keeps
            # its own documented read behavior.
            if job_raw != _jobs._serialize_submit_file(
                    accepted, job_map, job_events):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} is not in canonical "
                    "compact form")
            history, _supply_map, _supply_events, supply_raw = \
                _resources._load_file(supply_real)
            if supply_raw is None:
                raise FileNotFoundError(
                    f"supply file {supply_real!r} does not exist")
            trades, idempotency, old_bytes = _load_clear_ledger(
                ledger_real, accepted, history)

            job = accepted.get(job_id)
            if job is None:
                raise KeyError(job_id)

            binding = idempotency.get(key)
            if binding is not None:
                if binding["job_id"] != job_id or binding["at"] != at:
                    raise ValueError("idempotency key was already used with "
                                     "a different request")
                return copy.deepcopy(trades[job_id]), False
            if job_id in trades:
                raise ValueError("job is already traded under another "
                                 "idempotency key")

            # Capacity already sold per exact resource version; replays
            # never re-enter this path, so every recorded trade counts
            # exactly once and bookings never cross versions.
            sold: dict[tuple[str, int], int] = {}
            for trade in trades.values():
                slot = (trade["resource_id"], trade["version"])
                sold[slot] = sold.get(slot, 0) + trade["work"]

            work = job["work"]
            regions = set(job["regions"])
            residency = set(job["residency"])
            candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for records in history.values():
                active: dict[str, Any] | None = None
                for record in records:
                    if record["start"] <= at <= record["end"]:
                        active = record
                if active is None:
                    continue
                if active["region"] not in regions:
                    continue
                remaining = active["capacity"] - sold.get(
                    (active["resource_id"], active["version"]), 0)
                if remaining < work:
                    continue
                if not residency <= set(active["residency"]):
                    continue
                if active["end"] < job["deadline"]:
                    continue
                total_cost = work * active["unit_cost"]
                total_carbon = work * active["carbon_intensity"]
                if total_cost > job["max_cost"] \
                        or total_carbon > job["carbon_cap"]:
                    continue
                candidates.append({
                    "resource": dict(active),
                    "total_cost": total_cost,
                    "total_carbon": total_carbon,
                })

            candidates.sort(key=lambda entry: (
                entry["resource"]["carbon_intensity"],
                entry["resource"]["unit_cost"],
                entry["resource"]["resource_id"]))
            if not candidates:
                raise LookupError("no remaining feasible resource for job")

            winner = candidates[0]["resource"]
            resource_id = winner["resource_id"]
            version = winner["version"]
            trade: dict[str, Any] = {
                "job_id": job_id,
                "at": at,
                "work": work,
                "resource_id": resource_id,
                "version": version,
                "candidates": candidates,
                "selection": {"resource_id": resource_id,
                              "version": version},
            }
            trades[job_id] = trade
            idempotency[key] = {"job_id": job_id, "at": at}
            _commit_clear(ledger_real,
                          _canonical_clear_bytes(trades, idempotency),
                          old_bytes)
            return copy.deepcopy(trade), True

10	  idempotency key, the resource id and the version it created.

13	canonical compact form :func:`_serialize` produces -- fields and keys
14	in their fixed/code-point order, no whitespace beyond structural
15	tokens, non-ASCII written through and one trailing newline. Any
16	out-of-order section, extra whitespace, ``\\uXXXX``-escaped non-ASCII
17	character, or missing or duplicated final newline is a ``ValueError``.

20	:func:`get` reads one resource record back by id and optional version,
21	and :func:`feasible` joins a ``jobs.submit`` acceptance file with the
22	supply file under both shared locks to rank the resources that can

246	                or event_version > len(history[resource_id]):
247	            raise ValueError("audit event must reference a published "
248	                             "version")
249	        events[key] = {"key": event_key, "resource_id": resource_id,
250	                       "version": event_version}
251	
252	    # The three sections describe one publication history: each
253	    # idempotency key binds one resource and one publish event, the map
254	    # and the event agree on the resource, and every published version
255	    # is bound to exactly one event.
256	    if set(idempotency) != set(events):
257	        raise ValueError("idempotency keys and audit events do not match")
258	    for key, resource_id in idempotency.items():
259	        if events[key]["resource_id"] != resource_id:
260	            raise ValueError("audit event does not match its idempotency "
261	                             "entry")
262	    published = {(resource_id, record["version"])
263	                 for resource_id, records in history.items()
264	                 for record in records}
265	    bound = {(event["resource_id"], event["version"])
266	             for event in events.values()}
267	    if bound != published:
268	        raise ValueError("every published version must be bound to an "
269	                         "audit event")
270	
271	    return history, idempotency, events
272	
273	
274	def _canonical_bytes(
275	    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
276	    idempotency: dict[str, str],
277	    events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
278	) -> bytes:
279	    # The canonical wire form every reader accepts: compact UTF-8 JSON
280	    # with non-ASCII written through, sections in their fixed field order
281	    # and each section's primary keys in code-point order, terminated by
282	    # exactly one newline. The round trip also rejects duplicate keys
283	    # (json.loads keeps the last occurrence) and any escaping of
284	    # non-ASCII characters that json.dumps would write through.
285	    return _serialize(history, idempotency, events)
286	
287	
288	def _load_file(realpath: str) -> tuple[
289	    dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]], dict[str, str],
290	    dict[str, dict[str, Any]], bytes | None
291	]:
292	    try:
293	        with open(realpath, "rb") as handle:
294	            raw = handle.read()
295	    except FileNotFoundError:
296	        return {}, {}, {}, None
297	
298	    try:
299	        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
300	    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
301	        raise ValueError(
302	            f"supply file {realpath!r} is not valid UTF-8") from exc
303	    try:
304	        # Negative-zero and non-finite literals are format errors.
305	        data = finite_loads(text)
306	    except ValueError as exc:
307	        raise ValueError(
308	            f"supply file {realpath!r} is not valid JSON") from exc
309	    history, idempotency, events = _validate_structure(data)
310	    # Every read entry requires the on-disk bytes to be the canonical
311	    # form: fields and keys in their original order, compact JSON with
312	    # non-ASCII written through and exactly one trailing newline. Any
313	    # extra whitespace, escaped non-ASCII character, reordered field or
314	    # missing/duplicated final newline is a ValueError.
315	    if raw != _canonical_bytes(history, idempotency, events):
316	        raise ValueError(
317	            f"supply file {realpath!r} is not in canonical compact form")
318	    return history, idempotency, events, raw
319	
320	
321	def _serialize(
322	    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
323	    idempotency: dict[str, str],
324	    events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
325	) -> bytes:
326	    # Compact UTF-8 JSON, non-ASCII written through, each section's
327	    # primary keys in code-point order, terminated by exactly one newline.
328	    payload = {
329	        "version": _VERSION,
330	        "history": {resource_id: history[resource_id]
331	                    for resource_id in sorted(history)},
332	        "idempotency": {key: idempotency[key] for key in sorted(idempotency)},
333	        "audit": {key: events[key] for key in sorted(events)},
334	    }
335	    text = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"),
336	                      allow_nan=False) + "\n"
337	    return text.encode("utf-8")
338

340	def _fsync_directory(directory: str) -> None:
341	    dir_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY)
342	    try:
343	        os.fsync(dir_fd)
344	    finally:
345	        os.close(dir_fd)
346

348	def _rollback_file(realpath: str, directory: str,
349	                   old_bytes: bytes | None, first: BaseException) -> None:
350	    # Restore the exact pre-call bytes while the exclusive lock is held:
351	    # stage them back over the replaced file, or remove a file that did
352	    # not exist beforehand, then sync the directory. A failed recovery
353	    # surfaces chained after the original error.
354	    try:
355	        if old_bytes is None:
356	            try:
357	                os.unlink(realpath)
358	            except FileNotFoundError:
359	                pass
360	        else:
361	            fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
362	                dir=directory, prefix=".resources-restore-", suffix=".tmp")
363	            try:
364	                with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
365	                    handle.write(old_bytes)
366	                    handle.flush()
367	                    os.fsync(handle.fileno())
368	                os.replace(tmp_path, realpath)
369	            except BaseException:
370	                with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
371	                    os.unlink(tmp_path)
372	                raise
373	        _fsync_directory(directory)
374	    except OSError as recovery:
375	        raise recovery from first
376	
377	
378	def _commit_file(realpath: str, payload: bytes,
379	                 old_bytes: bytes | None) -> None:
380	    # One durable commit for the history, the idempotency map and the
381	    # audit event: same-directory temporary, fsync, atomic replace and a
382	    # directory fsync. Any failure after the replace restores the
383	    # pre-call bytes, so an unsuccessful publish leaves the original file
384	    # byte-for-byte.
385	    directory = os.path.dirname(realpath) or "."
386	    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
387	        dir=directory, prefix=".resources-", suffix=".tmp")
388	    try:
389	        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
390	            handle.write(payload)
391	            handle.flush()
392	            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
393	        os.replace(tmp_path, realpath)
394	    except BaseException:
395	        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
396	            os.unlink(tmp_path)
397	        raise
398	    try:
399	        _fsync_directory(directory)
400	    except BaseException as first:
401	        _rollback_file(realpath, directory, old_bytes, first)
402	        raise
403	
404	
405	def publish(
406	    path: str,
407	    resource: dict[str, object],
408	    idempotency_key: str,
409	) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
410	    """Persistently publish one resource-supply version.
411	
412	    ``path`` and ``idempotency_key`` must be non-empty strings. The
413	    resource must be an object with exactly the eight top-level fields
414	    resource_id, region, capacity, start, end, unit_cost,
415	    carbon_intensity and residency: non-empty id and region strings, a
416	    positive integer capacity, non-negative start, end, unit_cost and
417	    carbon_intensity (booleans rejected) with start not later than end,
418	    and a non-empty residency list of distinct non-empty strings sorted
419	    by code point that contains the resource's own region. Any
420	    deviation raises ``ValueError`` before the file is touched.
421	
422	    A first publication saves the canonical record -- the resource
423	    fields plus the next consecutive ``version`` for that resource id,
424	    starting at 1 -- together with the idempotency binding and a
425	    publish audit event carrying the key, the resource id and the
426	    version, all three in one durable commit, and returns
427	    ``(record, True)``. A new version of an already published resource
428	    must carry a strictly later start than the current latest version.
429	    Replaying the same key with an identical resource returns the
430	    stored record with ``False`` without adding an event or rewriting
431	    the file; the same key with a different resource raises
432	    ``ValueError`` and preserves the original bytes.
433	
434	    A missing parent directory raises ``FileNotFoundError``; an invalid
435	    existing file (encoding, JSON, negative-zero or non-finite numbers,
436	    version, structure, ordering, canonical bytes or references) raises
437	    ``ValueError``; any other locking or I/O failure raises ``OSError``.
438	    Calls serialize across threads and processes per resolved real path.
439	    """
440	    if not isinstance(path, str) or not path:
441	        raise ValueError("path must be a non-empty string")
442	    if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or not idempotency_key:
443	        raise ValueError("idempotency_key must be a non-empty string")
444	    normalized = _normalize_resource(resource)
445	    resource_id = normalized["resource_id"]
446	
447	    store = _get_store(path)
448	    with store.lock:
449	        # Opening the companion lock in a missing directory surfaces as
450	        # FileNotFoundError before the data file is created.
451	        with _process_lock(store.realpath):
452	            history, idempotency, events, old_bytes = _load_file(
453	                store.realpath)
454	
455	            existing_id = idempotency.get(idempotency_key)
456	            if existing_id is not None:
457	                event = events[idempotency_key]
458	                existing = history[existing_id][event["version"] - 1]
459	                if {field: existing[field]
460	                        for field in _RESOURCE_FIELDS} != normalized:
461	                    raise ValueError("idempotency key was already used with "
462	                                     "a different resource")
463	                return dict(existing), False
464	
465	            versions = history.get(resource_id)
466	            if versions is None:
467	                versions = []
468	                history[resource_id] = versions
469	                version = 1
470	            else:
471	                if normalized["start"] <= versions[-1]["start"]:
472	                    raise ValueError("resource start must increase across "
473	                                     "versions")
474	                version = versions[-1]["version"] + 1
475	
476	            record: dict[str, Any] = {
477	                "resource_id": resource_id,
478	                "version": version,
479	                "region": normalized["region"],
480	                "capacity": normalized["capacity"],
481	                "start": normalized["start"],
482	                "end": normalized["end"],
483	                "unit_cost": normalized["unit_cost"],
484	                "carbon_intensity": normalized["carbon_intensity"],
485	                "residency": list(normalized["residency"]),
486	            }
487	            versions.append(record)
488	            idempotency[idempotency_key] = resource_id
489	            events[idempotency_key] = {
490	                "key": idempotency_key,
491	                "resource_id": resource_id,
492	                "version": version,
493	            }
494	            _commit_file(store.realpath,
495	                         _serialize(history, idempotency, events), old_bytes)
496	            return dict(record), True
497	
498	
499	def get(
500	    path: str,
501	    resource_id: str,
502	    version: int | None = None,
503	) -> dict[str, object]:
504	    """Return a read-only copy of one published resource record.
505	
506	    ``path`` and ``resource_id`` must be non-empty strings and
507	    ``version``, when given, a non-boolean positive integer, else
508	    ``ValueError``. Without ``version`` the latest record of the
509	    resource is returned. A missing supply file raises
510	    ``FileNotFoundError``; an invalid file -- including non-canonical
511	    bytes -- raises ``ValueError``; an unknown resource id raises
512	    ``KeyError(resource_id)`` and an unknown version
513	    ``KeyError(version)``; any other locking or I/O failure raises
514	    ``OSError``. The call never writes, and the returned record is a
515	    fresh copy with resource_id, version, region, capacity, start, end,
516	    unit_cost, carbon_intensity and residency.
517	    """
518	    if not isinstance(path, str) or not path:
519	        raise ValueError("path must be a non-empty string")
520	    if not isinstance(resource_id, str) or not resource_id:
521	        raise ValueError("resource_id must be a non-empty string")
522	    if version is not None \
523	            and (not _is_plain_int(version) or version <= 0):
524	        raise ValueError("version must be a non-boolean positive integer")
525	
526	    realpath = os.path.realpath(path)
527	    with _process_lock(realpath, shared=True):
528	        history, _idempotency, _events, raw = _load_file(realpath)
529	    if raw is None:
530	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"supply file {realpath!r} does not exist")
531	    versions = history.get(resource_id)
532	    if versions is None:
533	        raise KeyError(resource_id)
534	    if version is None:
535	        return dict(versions[-1])
536	    if version > len(versions):
537	        raise KeyError(version)
538	    return dict(versions[version - 1])
539	
540	def feasible(
541	    job_path: str,
542	    supply_path: str,
543	    job_id: str,
544	    at: int,
545	) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
546	    """Rank the resources that can serve one accepted job at ``at``.
547	
548	    ``job_path`` and ``supply_path`` must be non-empty strings,
549	    ``job_id`` a non-empty string and ``at`` a non-boolean non-negative
550	    integer evaluation moment, else ``ValueError``. The job file must be
551	    a ``jobs.submit`` acceptance file -- a version-1 ``jobs.register``
552	    file is invalid structure -- and both files are read as complete
553	    snapshots while their shared locks are held together.
554	
555	    A missing acceptance or supply file raises ``FileNotFoundError``;
556	    an invalid file -- including a supply file outside canonical
557	    compact form -- raises ``ValueError``; an unknown job id raises
558	    ``KeyError(job_id)``; any other locking or I/O failure raises
559	    ``OSError``.
560	
561	    Each resource contributes only its highest version valid at ``at``
562	    (start not later than ``at`` not later than end). A candidate must
563	    sit in one of the job's regions, offer at least the job's work as
564	    capacity, cover the job's residency regions with its own residency
565	    list, and stay available at least until the job's deadline. The
566	    total cost is the job's work times the unit cost and the total
567	    carbon the work times the carbon intensity; a candidate exceeding
568	    the job's max_cost or carbon_cap budget is excluded. The result is
569	    ordered by carbon intensity, then unit cost, then resource id, each
570	    entry carrying the resource record and both totals; with no
571	    candidate the list is empty.
572	    """
573	    if not isinstance(job_path, str) or not job_path:
574	        raise ValueError("job_path must be a non-empty string")
575	    if not isinstance(supply_path, str) or not supply_path:
576	        raise ValueError("supply_path must be a non-empty string")
577	    if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
578	        raise ValueError("job_id must be a non-empty string")
579	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
580	        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")
581	
582	    job_real = os.path.realpath(job_path)
583	    supply_real = os.path.realpath(supply_path)
584	    # Lock both snapshots together, in a path order shared by every
585	    # caller, so concurrent calls can never deadlock.
586	    with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
587	        for locked in sorted({job_real, supply_real}):
588	            stack.enter_context(_process_lock(locked, shared=True))
589	
590	        accepted, _job_map, _job_events, job_raw = _jobs._load_submit_file(
591	            job_real)
592	        if job_raw is None:
593	            raise FileNotFoundError(
594	                f"acceptance file {job_real!r} does not exist")
595	        history, _idempotency, _events, supply_raw = _load_file(supply_real)
596	        if supply_raw is None:
597	            raise FileNotFoundError(
598	                f"supply file {supply_real!r} does not exist")
599	
600	        job = accepted.get(job_id)
601	        if job is None:
602	            raise KeyError(job_id)
603	
604	        work = job["work"]
605	        regions = set(job["regions"])
606	        residency = set(job["residency"])
607	        candidates: list[dict[str, object]] = []
608	        for records in history.values():
609	            active: dict[str, Any] | None = None
610	            for record in records:
611	                if record["start"] <= at <= record["end"]:
612	                    active = record
613	            if active is None:
614	                continue
615	            if active["region"] not in regions:
616	                continue
617	            if active["capacity"] < work:
618	                continue
619	            if not residency <= set(active["residency"]):
620	                continue
621	            if active["end"] < job["deadline"]:
622	                continue
623	            total_cost = work * active["unit_cost"]
624	            total_carbon = work * active["carbon_intensity"]
625	            if total_cost > job["max_cost"] \
626	                    or total_carbon > job["carbon_cap"]:
627	                continue
628	            candidates.append({
629	                "resource": dict(active),
630	                "total_cost": total_cost,
631	                "total_carbon": total_carbon,
632	            })
633	
634	    candidates.sort(key=lambda entry: (entry["resource"]["carbon_intensity"],
635	                                       entry["resource"]["unit_cost"],
636	                                       entry["resource"]["resource_id"]))
637	    return candidates
